insurance_intermediary_role.label: Insurance intermediary role
insurance_intermediary_role.value: Wholesale broker, binding authority provider and managing general underwriter serving retail brokers, agents and carriers

insurance_placement_niche.label: Insurance placement niche
insurance_placement_niche.value: Specialty insurance: wholesale brokerage, binding authority, national specialty programs, alternative risk, and benefits solutions

intermediary_compensation.label: Intermediary compensation
intermediary_compensation.value: Commissions paid by carriers on wholesale placements, plus underwriting-management fees and contingent commissions

carrier_market_access.label: Carrier / market access
carrier_market_access.value: Wholesale placement relationships with many carriers; delegated binding authority and underwriting-manager programs for carriers
